```go
var Addons = []string{
    "coredns",
    "servicelb",
    "traefik",
    "local-storage",
    "metrics-server",
    "runtimes",
}
```

<a name="CNIs"></a>CNIs is the set of values k3s v1\_37 accepts in \`cni:\`. Empty for distros that do not declare a CNI selection flag.

```go
var CNIs []string
```

<a name="IngressControllers"></a>IngressControllers is the set of values k3s v1\_37 accepts in \`ingress\-controller:\`. Empty for distros that do not declare one.
